changements.avant:

On an enemy:
• At the start of their turn, places a glyph that inflicts Earth, Fire, Water and Air damage around the target.

On an ally:

• Combo I to IV: -0 AP
• Combo V to IX: -1 AP
• Combo X to XV: -2 AP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

The wall of Water Bombs only removes AP from entities that start their turn inside it.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Water Bombs present on the field.
